Tensions rise in Strait of Hormuz following vessel attacks and US-Iran military actions

The Strait of Hormuz has become a focal point of escalating tensions between Iran and the United States, marked by attacks on oil tankers and US military strikes on Iranian assets. Reports indicate that oil tankers have turned back from the strait, and there are claims of an Indian oil tanker being affected. The situation involves diplomatic rhetoric from President Trump regarding potential deals and warnings against Iranian actions, alongside Iran's defiance and assertions about controlling the waterway.
